scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev -w @yottaflex/server" "npm run dev -w @yottaflex/client"
scripts.pipeline: npm run build:shared && tsx server/src/cli/index.ts pipeline
scripts.forecast: npm run build:shared && tsx server/src/cli/index.ts forecast
scripts.allocate: npm run build:shared && tsx server/src/cli/index.ts allocate
scripts.inject: npm run build:shared && tsx server/src/cli/index.ts inject
scripts.validate: npm run build:shared && tsx server/src/cli/index.ts validate
scripts.export: npm run build:shared && tsx server/src/cli/index.ts export
scripts.report: npm run build:shared && tsx server/src/cli/index.ts report
scripts.reproduce: npm run build:shared && tsx server/src/cli/index.ts reproduce
scripts.docs:schema: npm run build:shared && tsx server/src/cli/index.ts docs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && vitest run server/tests/integration
